verdict_reason: Present PE (142) is priced for growth EPS history doesn't support -- EPS fell from Rs.75 (073-074) to a Rs.13-36 range for 6 straight years while price ran up 20x+.
devils_advocate: Historical median (12.34) blends a pre-076-077 illiquid regime (PE 3-21) with the post-re-rating regime (PE 87-425) -- against the post-re-rating band alone, 142 is mid-pack, not extreme. Real question is whether the re-rating itself was ever earnings-justified; flat EPS says no.
